## Project overview

> Reach the output quality of fixed-interval KV refresh on LLaDA-V with fewer full refreshes, i.e. lower
> wall-clock at matched quality.

- **Problem**: Fast-dLLM refreshes the cache every k steps; high-agreement settings give only ~1.3–2.5× speedup.
- **Approach**: map where staleness flips tokens, then spend refreshes there (static, then cheap online policies).
- **Outcome target**: ≥ 25% lower wall-clock than fixed interval at matched quality on 2 of 3 anchors (G4).
- **Status (2026-10-29)**: Phase 1 reference done (G1 PASS); bad-case analysis done (Obs 1); Phase 2 next.

## Reproduction quickstart

```bash
bash scripts/setup_env.sh                 # CPU node: env llada-v, third_party clones
bash scripts/download_weights.sh          # CPU node: LLaDA-V + SigLIP-2 into /scratch HF cache
sbatch slurm/campaign.sbatch configs/campaigns/mme_caption_frontier.json   # Exp 3
python src/scripts/gate_check.py g1       # G1 verdict
python src/scripts/analyze_frontier.py    # Obs 1 summary + figures (llada-v env)
cd docs && quarto render
```
